story_type: man stranded on jetty in breaking waves, boat crew line rescue
hook: A boat's wake threw him overboard. Then the waves found him.
narration: A wave just broke right over this man, stuck on the rocks of a jetty.
He had been out fishing off Cape May, New Jersey, when another boat's wake threw him from his boat.
Now he was stranded on the jetty, and a Coast Guard response boat crew from Station Cape May was on the way.
A boat can't run right up to a jetty in breaking surf, because one swell could smash its hull onto the rocks. So the crew sends a line across instead.
Every few seconds, another wave rolled over the rocks around him. [short pause]
outcome: The Station Cape May boat crew rescued the man from the jetty.
title: A wake threw him from his boat
description:
A man was thrown from his fishing boat by another boat's wake and stranded on a jetty in Cape May, New Jersey, on June 4, 2014. A Coast Guard Station Cape May Response Boat Medium crew rescued him from the jetty.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Seaman Jeremy Brown, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/341222/coast-guard-rescues-1-jetty-cape-may-nj

facts.source_quote: The Coast Guard rescued a man from a jetty in Cape May, New Jersey, at about 3 p.m. Wednesday, June 4, after he was thrown from his fishing boat by another boat’s wake.

facts.claim: Station Cape May Response Boat Medium crew responded and rescued him
